result.title: Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key method for training AI models in scientific applications, but RL remains difficult when outputs cannot easily be verified against a known ground-truth answer. Natural-language weather forecast reports are one such domain: they translate atmospheric data into assessments of weather evolution, hazards, and uncertainty for both the general public and key decision-makers. Unlike numerical weather-analysis questions, they admit many valid outputs, which limits deterministic verification. To address this, we develop Zephyrus-R1, a practical framework for RL on scientific weather forecast reporting. We focus on three key components of the agentic RL pipeline: reward design, curriculum learning, and an analysis of human-expert alignment. To encourage both report legibility and factual accuracy, we design a reward function that combines a meteorological rubric with bidirectional claim entailment, both evaluated against National Weather Service reference reports. Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions and lead times before producing a report. We use annotations from three meteorologists to audit the claim labels produced by our LLM judges. Finally, a curriculum helps small models first develop tool use and scientific reasoning through RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions, then optimize the open-ended report reward. After training Qwen3.5-4B with Zephyrus-R1, we improve the mean across six judge-metric scores by 26% over the base model and achieve results competitive with frontier open-weight models. For Qwen3.8-27B, we improve the same mean by 13% over the base model, by 6.7% over Kimi-K3, and by 2.7% over GPT-5.6-Luna.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Zephyrus-R1，用 agentic RL 训练视觉-语言模型在工具调用环境中收集并分析预报证据、生成天气预报报告；方法核心是气象评分标准加双向 claim entailment 的奖励设计、由可验证问题过渡到开放式报告的课程学习，并以气象学家标注审核 LLM 评委。
AI.relevance_reason: 与主线无直接关系，但其「先可验证子任务、后开放式输出」的课程设计和多组分奖励，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取与 latent 状态监督、贡献分配的训练安排提供可供核查的方法线索。
